books.title: Bible
books.translationName: King James Version (Authorized Version, 1611)
books.license: KJV: public domain. Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via openscriptures/morphhb (CC BY 4.0). Greek: SBL Greek New Testament (CC BY-SA 4.0).
books.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

books.title: Bhagavad Gita
books.translationName: Open English rendering (gita-json / VedicScriptures dataset)
books.license: Sanskrit text and IAST: public domain. English rendering and dataset: MIT licence (github.com/AdiyogiArts/gita-json).

books.title: Rig Veda
books.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
books.license: Public domain translation (Griffith, 1896); transcription from Wikisource. Griffith’s commentary and notes are not included.
books.notes: Complete translation in Griffith’s arrangement: ten Maṇḍalas, one chapter per hymn, one verse per stanza. The Sanskrit text and Griffith’s commentary are not included. Hymn 1.179, which the 1896 edition prints only as an appendix note, is absent.

books.title: The Upanishads
books.translationName: The Upanishads (Sacred Books of the East, vols. I and XV)
books.license: Public domain translations (Müller, 1879 and 1884); proofread transcription from Wikisource.
books.notes: Seven of the principal Upanishads as Müller translated and numbered them: Chandogya, Kena (Talavakâra), Aitareya, Katha, Mundaka, Prasna and Taittiriya. The Aitareya is the Upanishad proper from Müller’s Aitareya-âranyaka (second âranyaka, adhyâyas 4–6), lifted out of the surrounding ritual text. The Sanskrit text is not part of this edition. Brihadâranyaka, Svetâsvatara and Maitrâyana are not bundled; see the registry for the reason.

books.title: Yoga Sutras
books.translationName: The Yoga Sutras of Patanjali: The Book of the Spiritual Man
books.license: Public domain translation (Johnston, 1912); transcribed by Project Gutenberg (eBook #2526).
books.notes: Each entry is one sutra as Johnston numbers it. The Sanskrit original is not included in this public-domain edition; Johnston’s interpretive wording is printed exactly as published.

books.title: Sama Veda
books.reason: No complete openly licensed English edition was reachable during this build.

books.title: Yajur Veda
books.reason: No complete openly licensed English edition was reachable during this build.

books.title: Atharva Veda
books.reason: No complete openly licensed English edition was reachable during this build.

books.title: Ramayana
books.reason: Griffith’s public-domain translation is not available as a clean machine-readable edition here; a verse-by-verse import is needed.

books.title: Mahabharata
books.reason: Ganguli’s public-domain translation is very large; it needs a dedicated import and verse segmentation pass that this build did not complete.

books.title: The Puranas
books.reason: Only partial public-domain translations (e.g. Wilson’s Vishnu Purana) exist and no reliable structured copy was reachable.

books.title: Dhammapada
books.translationName: The Dhammapada (Sacred Books of the East, vol. X)
books.license: Public domain translation (Müller, 1881). Pali root text: SuttaCentral sc-data, CC0.
books.notes: Pali root text could not be attached automatically; English translation is shown alone.

books.title: Tripitaka / Pali Canon
books.reason: The full canon is enormous. SuttaCentral (CC0) is the right source, but its bulk export was not reachable as structured files during this build.

books.title: Heart Sutra
books.reason: Public-domain translations exist; the Chinese original and English needed manual alignment that this build did not complete.

books.title: Diamond Sutra
books.reason: Public-domain translations exist; no clean machine-readable parallel edition was reachable.

books.title: Lotus Sutra
books.reason: Kern’s 1884 public-domain translation is identified in the Sacred Books of the East, but the reachable copy was not cleanly segmented by chapter.

books.title: Sri Guru Granth Sahib
books.translationName: BaniDB English rendering
books.license: BaniDB open data (Shabad OS). Gurmukhi text is scripture; the English rendering is the BaniDB edition — see SOURCES.md for its terms.

books.title: Tanakh
books.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
books.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
books.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

books.title: Talmud
books.reason: Sefaria’s English Talmud is CC BY-NC and very large; the public-domain Rodkinson edition covers only part of the Talmud and needs a dedicated import.

books.title: Midrash
books.reason: No complete openly licensed English digital edition was verified for automatic import.

books.title: Tattvartha Sutra
books.reason: No openly licensed, machine-readable English edition could be verified during this build.

books.title: Agamas
books.reason: The Agamas are largely untranslated into English in the public domain; no open digital edition was verified.

books.title: Avesta
books.reason: Darmesteter’s and Mills’s public-domain translations exist in the Sacred Books of the East, but the reachable copies were blocked and no structured edition was available.

books.title: Tao Te Ching
books.translationName: The Tâo Teh King (Sacred Books of the East, vol. 39)
books.license: Public domain translation (Legge, 1891); classical Chinese text public domain (Wang Bi edition, Chinese Wikisource).

books.title: Zhuangzi
